# Memory-pressure ranking cases copied from upstream Kubernetes.
#
#   source:  k8s.io/kubernetes v1.36.2
#   path:    pkg/kubelet/eviction/helpers_test.go
#   tests:   TestOrderedByExceedsRequestMemory, TestOrderedByPriority,
#            TestOrderedByMemory, TestOrderedByPriorityMemory
#   consts:  lowPriority = -1, defaultPriority = 0, highPriority = 1
#            (pkg/kubelet/eviction/eviction_manager_test.go)
#
# Each case is transcribed, not re-derived: the pods, their priorities, their
# memory requests, their working sets (newPodMemoryStats), the input order and
# the expected order are upstream's. CPU and limits are dropped because no memory
# comparator reads them.
#
# Format:
#   case <upstream test name> <comparator,...>   comparators: exceed, priority, memory
#   pod <name> <priority> <memory request|-> <working set|nostats>
#   input <names in upstream's input order>
#   want <names in upstream's expected order>
#   end

case TestOrderedByExceedsRequestMemory exceed
pod below-requests -1 200Mi 199Mi
pod exceeds-requests 1 100Mi 101Mi
input below-requests exceeds-requests
want exceeds-requests below-requests
end

case TestOrderedByPriority priority
pod low-priority -134 - nostats
pod medium-priority 1 100Mi nostats
pod high-priority 12534 200Mi nostats
input high-priority medium-priority low-priority
want low-priority medium-priority high-priority
end

case TestOrderedByMemory memory
pod best-effort-high 0 - 500Mi
pod best-effort-low 0 - 300Mi
pod burstable-high 0 100Mi 800Mi
pod burstable-low 0 100Mi 300Mi
pod guaranteed-high 0 1Gi 800Mi
pod guaranteed-low 0 1Gi 200Mi
input best-effort-high best-effort-low burstable-high burstable-low guaranteed-high guaranteed-low
want burstable-high best-effort-high best-effort-low burstable-low guaranteed-high guaranteed-low
end

case TestOrderedByPriorityMemory exceed,priority,memory
pod above-requests-low-priority-high-usage -1 - 500Mi
pod above-requests-low-priority-low-usage -1 - 50Mi
pod above-requests-high-priority-high-usage 1 100Mi 600Mi
pod above-requests-high-priority-low-usage 1 100Mi 150Mi
pod below-requests-low-priority-high-usage -1 1Gi 800Mi
pod below-requests-low-priority-low-usage -1 1Gi 200Mi
pod below-requests-high-priority-high-usage 1 1Gi 800Mi
pod below-requests-high-priority-low-usage 1 1Gi 200Mi
input below-requests-high-priority-low-usage below-requests-high-priority-high-usage below-requests-low-priority-low-usage below-requests-low-priority-high-usage above-requests-high-priority-low-usage above-requests-high-priority-high-usage above-requests-low-priority-low-usage above-requests-low-priority-high-usage
want above-requests-low-priority-high-usage above-requests-low-priority-low-usage above-requests-high-priority-high-usage above-requests-high-priority-low-usage below-requests-low-priority-high-usage below-requests-low-priority-low-usage below-requests-high-priority-high-usage below-requests-high-priority-low-usage
end
